narr: Organized convection developed across northern Arizona with heavy rain and rotation in some storms.
ev: Cataract Creek at Redlands Crossing rose two feet in less than an hour due to heavy rainfall upstream.
The river gauge on Granite Creek near Watson Lake rose 5 feet in a flash flood due to heavy rain from a thunderstorm.

A 10-12 inch rise was reported on Hess Creek in Heber-Overgaard. The creek came out of its banks putting debris on the roadway and threatening one home. This prompted using sand bags to protect the home.
Law enforcement reported flooding along State Route 87 and Indian Route 60 in Dilkon.
lsr: USGS RIVER GAUGE, GRWA3, MEASURED A 5 FOOT RISE ON GRANITE CREEK NEAR WATSON LAKE DUE TO HEAVY RAIN FROM A THUNDERSTORM.
A 10-12 INCH RISE WAS REPORTED ON HESS CREEK IN HEBER-OVERGAARD. THE CREEK CAME OUT OF ITS BANKS PUTTING DEBRIS ON THE ROADWAY AND THREATENING ONE RESIDENTIAL HOME WHICH HAD TO BE SANDBAGGED.
CATARACT CREEK AT REDLANDS CROSSING ROSE 2 FEET IN LESS THAN AN HOUR DUE TO HEAVY RAINFALL UPSTREAM.
LAW ENFORCEMENT IN DILKON REPORTED ONGOING FLOODING ALONG SR 87 AND ROUTE 60 IN DILKON.
